Earlier history remains in the complete source snapshot; missing standalone manuscripts are not reconstructed. E16 Revised supersedes original E16. ## Active prospective continuity At the end of E26, morning: Kaze and Briar are on foot beside the road to Lask, within speaking range of Samira on Orren's approaching wagon. Lask has not been reached. Kaze has six silver in the tracked tranche; healed functional injuries, persistent torn trousers/blood/dust. Briar stays; pillory intact. Samira's wrist is braced, specialist weapons remain stolen BELLY loot; her letter remains with Orren undelivered. Kratos departed alone toward the quarry hills; Baldur's escape is a witness report, not current tracking. Four overnights since E20 have passed. Kaze romance is OFF prospectively; established history is preserved. Full manuscript and checkpoint control knowledge and unresolved details. E21 presentation correction remains unapplied; E25 created later Elise/Samira encounters, not rewritten first meetings.

Read-only navigational encyclopedia and production index for S7NS. Not canon and never a replacement for the project's authoritative source hierarchy.
## Current orientation
- Branch: S3_RESET_CAMPFIRE_CANON_CHRIS_RETOLD_20261017
- Delivered: Season 3 Episode 26, Room to Move. Episodes 21–26 reconciled; author acceptance is not inferred.
- Next: Episode 27, authorized; prepared state remains distinct from delivery.
- Current solo focus: Kaze and Briar together on the Lask road; Samira nearby aboard Orren's wagon. Kaze romance OFF prospectively; Briar stays; history preserved.
- Startup: [Connected PLAY instructions](https://github.com/kazekamimp3/kaze808/blob/main/PLAY_START_HERE.md), then continuity/DELIVERY_LEDGER.json and continuity/CURRENT.json. Do not use the older E20 snapshot as the live cursor.
## Where truth lives
- MANIFEST.yaml and authority/Resolution_Register.json control file routing and conflict resolution.
- authority/Character_Removal_20261018.json controls identity exclusion.
- continuity/DELIVERY_LEDGER.json and continuity/CURRENT.json route to the newest matching-branch evidence; state/Post_Chris_Restart.json remains the preserved E20 baseline.
- `canon/presentation/Season3_Scene_Decision_Doctrine_20261010.md` is the sole story construction procedure.
- Complete mechanics, voice, psychology and relationship owners remain mandatory when relevant.
## Production integrations
Airtable reference base: S7NS Continuity Control (Reference), 784 records after the E21–26 handoff, including the unchanged 453 source-owner routes; affected handoff fields were read back exactly. Existing Drive production folders preserve the original verified source snapshot and exact E19/E20 pairs, plus the readback-verified exact delivered E21–26 manuscripts and original checkpoints. All seven encyclopedia sections are populated in place. GitHub is now connected: private `kazekamimp3/kaze808`, selected-repository App scope, 44 exact imported files and a successful remote source-integrity run. The verified import is commit `a8796b3bd4c5c2b94c893b55db9dcc79fca5b703`; checkpoint branch `checkpoint/s7ns-verified-import-20261018` preserves it. AI Voice Generator is excluded by author direction; no active narration provider is selected. Research and visual production retain source/approval gates.
## Populated sections
Characters, mechanics and restrictions, episode archive, consequences, author decisions, research and evidence, approved visuals, and audio playback. Populated as derived source directories; full source owners remain mandatory. Historical current labels cannot override newer scoped author instructions.
## Change control
Proposed change -\> authorized owner + routes updated -\> manifest hashes updated -\> validation -\> confirmed installation readback -\> only authorized PLAY -\> provisional delivery -\> author acceptance separately.
